steps.title: Add JSDoc prop types to the entity-mention components
steps.acceptance: Only JSDoc/comment changes in src/components/common/EntityMentionTextarea.jsx and src/components/common/EntityMentionRenderer.jsx, with no runtime or behaviour change. (1) EntityMentionTextarea: reword the header comment so '@-mentions' is no longer parsed as a JSDoc tag (TS1003 at 10,30), and add an @param props typedef that marks campaignId, placeholder, rows and className as optional. This clears roughly 25 TS2741 'campaignId is missing' errors in the *Fields.jsx, SchemaFields, RelationshipDialog, EntityLinker, NewSessionDialog and SessionDebrief call sites. (2) EntityMentionRenderer: type its props so className is optional (clears TS2741 at EntityStatBlockView 156 and EntityTypeView 205), and type the inner mention component's props to accept the entityId it is passed (clears TS2322 at 42,13). Count from 'npx tsc -p ./jsconfig.json --pretty false' must drop below 729 (target about 700 or fewer). Lint, tests and build pass. Do not touch .typecheck-baseline, src/components/ui or any forbidden path. No changelog.
steps.note: App typecheck errors went from 729 to 698 (ratchet). The baseline was left unchanged. Two existing TS2322 errors remain (autoFocus is passed to EntityMentionTextarea at SessionNotesPanel:138 and CampaignNotes:81 but never forwarded), which is a behaviour gap for a later slice. scripts/scripts.test.mjs fails to load on this Windows checkout (SyntaxError on importing deploy-functions.mjs).
